## Scope and source notes

CAMT053 can be ordered in Online Banking; LLB Connect explicitly supports 053/054 with an account, E-Banking access, Connect agreement and compatible ERP. The separate PSD2 JSON API is not a CAMT sample source. No public raw original or ISO version verified.
